name: Slime Shape Obby
desc:
Welcome to Slime Shape Hobby!

Imagine that you are a sticky slime that can change shape. In this game you become a slime that can transform into 3 shapes: a default slime, a sphere slime and a square slime. You can also climb walls, quickly descend ramps and launch on jumps or cannons!

🏁 Complete the game using your shape-shifting abilities!
💯100+ Stages!
🤑Premium Benefits: 2x slimeball collection
Thank you all for your support :D
